name: Skai (Skai Delacroix)
reason: His work is quantum energy healing presented as treating illness: both Shift Network courses (Harness ZeroPoint, Living From ZeroPoint) promise immune, autoimmune, toxin and 'specific condition' healing, and his own site (kaenergetics.com) offers sessions for chronic disease and trauma; his linked YouTube channel no longer exists, leaving only a $2 memoir ebook and an undated live cohort that would pass the health-claim rule.
